name: Determine the molarity of potassium permanganate using 0.1 M oxalic acid
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: User-supplied NCERT XII Chemistry lelm106.pdf; PDF pages 3 (1-based). File SHA-256 in data/quantity_source_manifest.json.
educational_goal: Study 'Determine the molarity of potassium permanganate using 0.1 M oxalic acid' using a selected NCERT XII chemistry protocol, its documented quantities and conditions, and conditional observations; review unresolved doses before rendering.
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.

protocol_variants.title: KMnO4 against 0.1 M oxalic acid
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.
notes: The old catalogue title said 0.05 M. Experiment 6.1 explicitly uses 0.1 M; do not reuse the old concentration.
Preparation of oxalic acid is cross-referenced to the Class XI manual and is not specified here.

procedure_steps.instruction: Rinse and fill the burette with permanganate; remove nozzle bubbles and note the initial upper-meniscus reading.
procedure_steps.observation: Burette contains the titrant; no endpoint volume is predetermined.

quantities.note: Burette charge and consumed volume are not fixed; determine by titration.

procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Pipette 10 mL 0.1 M oxalic acid into a conical flask and add about 5 mL 1 M sulphuric acid.
procedure_steps.observation: The initial flask liquid is clear and colourless.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Heat to 50-60 degrees C and titrate with gentle swirling until permanent light pink; use fresh aliquots for three concordant readings.
procedure_steps.observation: Permanganate initially decolourises throughout the mixed contents; the endpoint is pale pink, not opaque white.

quantities.note: Endpoint-controlled; maximum added volume not stated.
